subject: Your Dettol order: delivery tomorrow
body: Good evening Dr. Mehta, thank you for your time today. Confirming your order of 20 Dettol antiseptic liquid and 10 Dettol handwash, scheduled for delivery tomorrow (10 Nov). I have also noted your point about Dettol liquid not being used undiluted on wounds and will share it with our team. Regards, Sneha Iyer, Northwind Distributors
